MiniMaxRerankAdapter — second-stage reranking via MiniMax chat completions.

MiniMax's M2 models do not support response_format on chat completions, so this adapter relies on a strict prompt plus low temperature and reasoning_split to keep the response parseable.

../../core/pipeops, ../../ports/reranking, llm_rerank_common, ../http/std_http, ../provider/minimax
